editorialNotes: Preserve FK/IK direction, straight-arm 180° geometry, IK hint vs joint limits vs skinning, extra controls and runtime tradeoffs. Test the actual UE mannequin's shoulder and elbow. The additional-control comparison is an independent mathematical chain, not a second game character's hidden rig.
